args: set -euo pipefail; t=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q . "$t/r"; cd "$t/r"; cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace; cargo build --manifest-path crates/worker/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; pnpm --dir adapters/dsh install; pnpm --dir adapters/dsh check; gitleaks detect --redact --source .
set -euo pipefail; gh repo view bradheitmann/model-tier-drop --json visibility,licenseInfo | jq -e '.visibility == "PUBLIC" and .licenseInfo.name == "Apache License 2.0"'
set -euo pipefail; gh run list --repo bradheitmann/model-tier-drop --limit 1 --json conclusion | jq -e '.[0].conclusion == "success"'

evidence_required: Fresh-clone outputs of every CI command.
gh run list --limit 1 output (or the exact failure).
objective: Write the README and docs for strangers, prove every CI command from a fresh clone, publish the public repository and confirm CI is green.
risk_controls: Publication happens only from main after the QA gate.
Three-attempt budget for making CI green; a fourth attempt is escalated, never taken silently.
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
rollback: The repository can be made private with gh repo edit --visibility private if a defect is found after publication.
steps: README: the rule in one screen, layout, install CLI, walkthrough (from S-03), hosted MCP (URL, add to Claude Code / Codex / dsh / Pi), dsh adapter, eval and dataset summary, development (fmt, clippy, test, wasm build, adapter check, gitleaks), licence.
Run every CI command locally from a fresh clone in a temporary directory.
gh repo create bradheitmann/model-tier-drop --public --source . --remote origin --push (from main after the QA gate), set description and topics.
Confirm CI runs green on GitHub (gh run list), fix if not, within the three-attempt budget.
